original.statement: In the notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta3 schema of providers.notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io, the allowed values of spec.type changed between flux v2.6.4 and v2.7.0: the values "otel" and "zulip" were added and no previously allowed value was removed, so nothing that validated before is rejected.

decision.reason: The computed artifact diff between [ev-782bc47d120d] (v2.6.4) and [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] (v2.7.0) records that the v1beta3 Provider spec.type enum gained "otel" and "zulip" and lost no values. The only environments that touch this change are those with a v1beta3 Provider that sets spec.type, and the proposed resource/field-set condition expresses exactly that. Because no value was removed, these environments face no consequence (kind none), and the condition does not claim any mandatory work. Confidence is low because the evidence excerpts themselves show only "apiVersion: v1" and not the enum contents.
